noRepository.title: No repository to browse
noRepository.body: Enter a repository on the Registries page, like ghcr.io/acme/app or nginx.

hide.label: Hide signature, attestation and cache tags

paging.error: Couldn't load more tags. Try again.

tags.capped: The repository has more tags than Coaming reads, so only the first {{count}} are listed.

onlyHidden.title: Only signature and attestation tags are left.

login_refused.message: Coaming couldn't sign in to {{host}} with credential “{{name}}” ({{scope}}). Test it.

needs_login.message: {{host}} needs a login to list tags, and no stored credential matches {{repo}}. Add one.

repository_unavailable.message: {{host}} has no repository {{repo}} that credential “{{name}}” ({{scope}}) can read. It may not exist, or the account may not have access.

registry_unreachable.message: Couldn't reach {{host}}. Check the address and try again.

registry_tls.message: The certificate from {{host}} isn't trusted. Add the registry's CA to its credential under Advanced, then try again.

rate_limited.message: {{host}} is limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.

too_fast.message: Too many tag requests. Wait a minute and try again.
too_fast.details: Too many requests, so some details haven't loaded. Wait a minute, then scroll those rows out of view and back.

ref_invalid.message: Enter an image like nginx:1.27 or ghcr.io/acme/app:latest.

generic.message: Couldn't load the tags. Check the connection and try again.

empty.title: No repository to browse
empty.body: This image has no name or registry digest, so Coaming can't tell where it came from.

missing.label: No {{arch}}
missing.tooltip: Nodes in {{env}} run {{arch}}, and this tag doesn't include it.

actions.label: Actions for {{tag}}
actions.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
